purpose: English-only, provenance-first general-purpose model learning; independently evaluate base weights and the integrated cognitive system.

language_policy.note: No non-English corpora, non-English task examples, tokenizer targets, or evaluation scenarios are permitted in the training pipeline.

stages.name: foundation_pretraining

mixture.note: Document weights are a pilot hypothesis. Measure actual token shares after SentencePiece tokenization and adjust only from held-out loss and quality results.

datasets.revision: resolve once at run start and record SHA

caveats: Both corpora derive from Common Crawl and require attribution/terms review.
Regex/privacy screening is not a complete PII audit.
FineWeb-Edu is a quality-filtered subset; deduplicate it against FineWeb before training.
The sample-10BT configuration is not a promise that 10B tokens are actually consumed by a bounded pilot.
stages.promotion: held-out next-token loss, source/time holdouts, document quality, privacy review, and contamination analysis

stages.name: domain_adaptive_pretraining
stages.method: continued next-token learning with a replay mixture of general English

datasets.license_policy: per-repository and per-file exact SPDX evidence; allowlist only reviewed permissive licences
datasets.filter: syntax, secrets/contact data, source hashes, repository-grouped split

datasets.use: domain adaptation only; web text is not verified answer supervision

stages.promotion: domain uplift without unacceptable general-English forgetting

stages.name: instruction_sft

datasets.filter: lang=en; review_result=true; deleted=false; synthetic=false; exclude positive PII labels

stages.promotion: protected English instruction-following and factuality regression suite

stages.name: task_sft

datasets.split: official train only; keep official test out
approved task IDs only; attribution retained

stages.promotion: exact-answer math, compile and unit-test code evaluation

stages.name: human_preference_learning

datasets.notes: Preference data is not dialogue SFT. Review upstream warning about training dialogue agents on preference-model data; do not automatically merge red-team data into SFT.

stages.promotion: human preference agreement and regression checks

stages.name: teacher_candidate_data

datasets.license: follow the exact model/API terms and output provenance
datasets.notes: DeepSeek's public report describes its training methodology but does not publish its full base pretraining corpus. Outputs can be considered only as new, traceable candidate examples with independent verification and human review.

stages.promotion: verified targets, source/version provenance, human review, contamination checks

stages.name: verified_outcome_training
datasets: private English code tasks authored by the project
English math tasks with deterministic exact validators
structured API/tool tasks with sandboxed action outcomes
stages.promotion: isolated execution, private holdouts, no reward hacking

stages.name: environment_outcome_optimization
stages.promotion: matched-budget success rate, verifier integrity, rollback and reward-hacking analysis

reference_labs.name: Anthropic
reference_labs.what_is_public: Claude transparency materials describe broad categories of proprietary training data, not a downloadable complete pretraining corpus. HH-RLHF is a separately available preference dataset.
reference_labs.not_available: The proprietary Claude base pretraining mixture and private licensed corpora.

reference_labs.name: DeepSeek
reference_labs.what_is_public: DeepSeek technical reports describe broad public/licensed data and data-quality methods. DeepSeek-R1's release provides model/code terms and discusses permitted use of model outputs for distillation.
reference_labs.not_available: A complete itemised base-model pretraining corpus.

reference_labs.name: OpenAI
reference_labs.what_is_public: Public research and model documentation describe methods and some dataset families, but not a complete itemised training inventory for this model.
reference_labs.not_available: A complete exact list of the datasets used to train ChatGPT.

reference_labs.name: AI2 OLMo
reference_labs.what_is_public: Open model and dataset releases such as Dolma provide a more auditable public research path.
reference_labs.not_available: This does not imply access to every upstream work without source-level terms review.

alternative_english_pretraining.warning: Very large; audit release version, component sources, terms, privacy and deduplication.
Check component licences and exact release; deduplicate against FineWeb.

alternative_english_pretraining.status: evaluate after storage/compute and licence review
alternative_english_pretraining.warning: Multi-terabyte scale; do not stack blindly with FineWeb due web-crawl overlap.

compute.github_actions: CPU tests and orchestration only; GitHub Actions does not provide a training GPU.

cpu_fallback_profile.note: Small pipeline pilot, not equivalent to the GPU schedule.

per_cycle.english_instruction_phase: response-only Aya SFT restricted to language code eng

invariants: Only English text enters the training pipeline.
The next cycle resumes only the foundation checkpoint, never an SFT candidate.
The SentencePiece tokenizer and vocabulary are reused byte-identically after the first cycle.
Every web sample passes the explicit English label and language-confidence gate.
Aya accepts only language code eng.
No model-generated examples enter training without human review and independent verification.
The Kaggle state dataset remains private and stores checkpoints, tokenizer, manifests and hashes, never API credentials.
continuous_cycle.promotion: A completed cycle produces a candidate only; promotion requires protected exact-answer, isolated code-execution, factuality, and regression evaluations.
